shared_scenarios.precondition: Fresh fictional organization with billing and paid SMS disabled
shared_scenarios.operation: Create the organization, administrator, fourteen members, and a qualified replacement
shared_scenarios.expected: No subscription, provider credential, or foreign organization access is required

shared_scenarios.precondition: Administrator is authenticated in an owned organization
shared_scenarios.operation: Invite members and assign every scheduling qualification
shared_scenarios.expected: Invitations are single-use and qualifications do not grant administrator access

shared_scenarios.precondition: Member has a scheduling qualification and an active session
shared_scenarios.expected: The solver excludes the member and another member cannot edit the record

shared_scenarios.precondition: Fourteen qualified members and twelve primary or secondary events exist
shared_scenarios.operation: Generate and review the complete six-week roster
shared_scenarios.expected: Every event has seven distinct qualified people with no overlaps or hard violations

shared_scenarios.operation: Explicitly accept, decline, or request a swap while the administrator follows up
shared_scenarios.expected: Unanswered and explicit responses remain distinguishable in every view

shared_scenarios.precondition: A published qualified member requests replacement
shared_scenarios.operation: Cover exactly one eligible open or swap assignment
shared_scenarios.expected: One qualified reserve wins and the original assignment transfers without duplication

shared_scenarios.precondition: A future published roster contains a session that must change
shared_scenarios.operation: Move or cancel only the intended occurrence and regenerate the horizon
shared_scenarios.expected: Unrelated future commitments remain and affected members must respond to changed work

shared_scenarios.precondition: Week one is complete and five future weeks remain
shared_scenarios.operation: Add week seven and restore a rolling six-week horizon
shared_scenarios.expected: Completed history and unrelated future commitments remain unchanged

shared_scenarios.precondition: An owned local mail sink is configured and paid delivery is disabled
shared_scenarios.operation: Send invitations, reset links, schedule changes, and reminders
shared_scenarios.expected: Captured content is usable and failed or disabled delivery is never labeled delivered

shared_scenarios.precondition: The member has current published assignments
shared_scenarios.operation: Subscribe to or download the personal calendar across a schedule change
shared_scenarios.expected: Current entries appear once with no foreign assignments and a non-UTC case is correct

shared_scenarios.precondition: The member has a valid account and captured recovery channel
shared_scenarios.operation: Log out and in, change password, and recover through a reset link
shared_scenarios.expected: Expired, replayed, or stale credentials fail without losing the account

shared_scenarios.precondition: Church and Basketball organizations coexist with separate identities
shared_scenarios.operation: Perform member and administrator operations in both organizations
shared_scenarios.expected: Every read and mutation remains tenant-scoped and volunteers cannot administer

scenarios.precondition: Fourteen qualified members and twelve events exist
scenarios.operation: Solve and publish the baseline six-week roster
scenarios.expected: All seven role slots are distinct, qualified, non-overlapping, and fairly distributed

scenarios.precondition: One worship leader is unavailable in week two
scenarios.expected: The other qualified worship leader covers the affected service

scenarios.precondition: A second service overlaps the week-three service
scenarios.expected: Fourteen distinct assignments cover both events without double-booking

scenarios.precondition: Both worship leaders are unavailable in week four
scenarios.operation: Generate and attempt to review the incomplete draft
scenarios.expected: The worship-leader shortage is explicit and the draft cannot replace the live roster

scenarios.precondition: Week four has a worship-leader shortage
scenarios.operation: Invite a qualified replacement and regenerate
scenarios.expected: The replacement repairs every affected event without substituting another role

scenarios.operation: Move the event, regenerate, and publish
scenarios.expected: The new time is live and stale assignments are hidden and rejected

scenarios.precondition: An assigned member has a draft and then published shift
scenarios.operation: Open the schedule and explicitly accept
scenarios.expected: The draft is hidden and the published assignment becomes confirmed only after acceptance

scenarios.precondition: A member requests a swap for a published role
scenarios.operation: A reserve with the same qualification covers the shift
scenarios.expected: The reserve gains one assignment and the original member loses it without a role gap
